name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
summary: US measles cases pass 5,100 in 2026, the most since 1991; PAHO panel reviewing US elimination status from 10 Nov
state: The CDC counted 5,182 US measles cases in 2026 as of 5 Nov, the most since 1991 (Al Jazeera, 7 Nov). Infant deaths announced in New York on 2 Nov and Wisconsin on 5 Nov were the seventh and eighth US measles deaths this year, and a PAHO advisory panel began a four-day review of US elimination status on 10 Nov (Healio, 9 Nov). Large outbreaks in a high-income country meet Watch; loss of elimination status would also be Watch, and a multi-country surge with rising deaths is not clearly established.
for_you: Two MMR doses give strong protection. The NHS and UKHSA advise checking vaccination records before travel, and CDC publishes US outbreak updates. Anyone with measles symptoms should phone their GP or NHS 111 before attending in person.
rubric_hit: Watch: large outbreaks in a high-income country (US 5,182 cases to 5 Nov); elimination status under PAHO review

sources.title: Al Jazeera — CDC reports more than 5,000 measles cases, highest number in 35 years
Healio — States report first measles deaths in decades ahead of PAHO meeting

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
